title: ​​Mom Realizes Police Discovered Her Disgusting Secret
description:
On December 26th, 2022, officers were dispatched regarding a high school teacher, planning to get her 15-year-old daughter involved in a se*ual activity, with her boyfriend on Christmas night. Police were alerted by the elder daughter when she received screenshots of the plan from her younger adoptive sister, which the latter saw in their mother’s WhatsApp chat. The victim told the officers that her mother’s boyfriend began talking to her about a website he was building, but she saw his messages to her mom where he wanted to buy the teenager new panties and have s*x with her to make her a woman. The sensitive information has been censored by the police department. The boyfriend told the mother that her daughter needed to be naked for him to train her and that she might be surprised if she crawled into his bed while he was naked. He also wanted her to perform oral s*x on him as part of the training. Based on the information provided by the victim, the police decided to place her mother under arrest. The mother told the officers that she was only trying to bluff her boyfriend and lure him into confessing that he was interested in younger girls. However, the victim stated that her mother had already asked her to go to the man’s house on Christmas night. The police conducted an undercover call between the teenager and the man, during which she mentioned that she was 15 years old. The man responded that she looked 23 to him, like a grown woman. The mother had also made arrangements for the man to pick her daughter up, take her to his house to engage in s*xual activities, and then return her home. The woman was charged with soliciting a child for unlawful s*xual conduct using a computer, unlawful use of a two-way communications device, and sharing unconsented information. Additionally, the judge set her bond at $28,000 and barred her and her boyfriend from making any contact with the victim or using any device capable of texting.

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
